body: PassScan runs records.ReleaseHooks.BeforeRelease (metadata only, file seen as ready) then emits file.status_changed and the new core event file.released. Describers that read bytes in BeforeCreate/BeforeReplace (dimensions, audio, video, pdf) skip File.Quarantined() files and describe them in BeforeRelease; async plugins (variants eager, ocr, pdf Process, vision) skip quarantined files and start on file.released; their explicit APIs (variants generate, ocr/pdf Process, vision Label, videoplatform Publish) refuse with records.ErrQuarantined. ReplaceObject sets next.Status to quarantined before ReplaceHooks under QuarantineContent so hooks can skip. contrib/tus gained Config.Resolve (resolved at create and at the final PATCH) so upload sessions apply to tus.
title: Quarantine release: ReleaseHooks for in-row describers, file.released event for after-commit work
